newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris airports' Q1 freighter traffic up 21.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Paris airports' Q1 freighter traffic up 21.8 pct.

text.p: Full-freighter flights at the Paris airports in the first quarter of 1997 totalled 5,354, up 21.8 percent on the same period last year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighter flights operating at Paris-CDG between January-March totalled 4,873, an increase of 25.7 percent.
However, freighter flights from Orly airport fell by 7.1 percent to 481, reflecting a gradual switch of such services to CDG, an Aeroports de Paris source said.

Total air cargo throughput in the first quarter amounted to 273,110 tonnes, with the full freighters' traffic share at 40.1 percent of the overall figure compared to 39.9 percent in January-March 1996.
In tonnage terms, freighters moved 109,455 tonnes in the first three months of the year, a rise of of 3.2 percent on 1996 levels.
Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.6 percent of all flights operating at the Paris airports in January-March compared to 3.1 percent in the same 1996 period.
